recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20843 unless a future mapping-language decision changes the allowed StructureMap.group.typeMode codes.
issue_request: FHIR-20843 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureMap change request asking to remove `none` from the value set used by StructureMap.group.typeMode, motivated by the concrete syntax treating typeMode as optional rather than requiring a `none` sentinel.
initial_application: The historical implementation commit e7ab035ff3872b1c0980a883b9602256f2d67bdb, merged as a572c61cf7ff2cb1b47b4ebfd9e7f40f3b3adf24 in PR #977, removed `typeMode value="none"` from examples, changed the StructureMap spreadsheet cardinality from 1..1 to 0..1, and removed the `none` row from the group type mode binding source used at that time.
additional_context: StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative StructureMap XML has StructureMap.group.typeMode as 0..1 with short `types | type-and-types`, and the current CodeSystem/ValueSet source defines only `types` and `type-and-types`. R5 published history also shows only those two map-group-type-mode codes. Zulip records show FHIR-I block vote and PR coordination references; Confluence searches found no conflicting later record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build source already implements the requested removal of `none` and optionality for StructureMap.group.typeMode.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned with FHIR-20843 in the StructureMap PR coordination thread, but it concerns allowing mapping groups with zero rules and was not needed to decide this issue.
